entities.summary: Joseph Paul Tamatea Moody is a retired New Zealand rugby union footballer who played as a prop for the Crusaders in Super Rugby and Canterbury in the Bunnings NPC. He made his debut for New Zealand in 2014 and has 57 international caps.
